Page 10, Phase 1: three capybara directions

Each direction is drawn straight in RML (docs/design/mascot/directions/<dir>/scene.rml, two artboards: Side and ThreeQuarter). Every picture here was rendered headless by the Rive CLI 1.9.1 from that file, so what you pick is the art we rig, with nothing redrawn. The palette is the mascot palette (body #C6894F, shade #B27A42, snout #8B5E3E), with gradients on the mascot only and no purple. The yuzu is marigold #EFA00B with a green leaf. Small sizes were rendered at 2x (Redmi S2 density) and shown at 40 and 120 CSS px. Pick one direction, or one plus a part to borrow from another (for example "C with B's eyes").

A

Loaf: the realistic one, calm half-lids

Idea
  • True capybara anatomy: barrel body, long blunt muzzle that shades softly into the fur, eyes high and set back, tiny ears.
  • The half-lidded "unbothered" eyes are the capybara meme. Chill reads before cute.
  • Rig: the spike's own build (one body path skinned to 2 bones, back and head). 18 to 23 shapes, 1 clip.
Watch
  • The eyes are the weakest at 40 px: a dark sliver. Happy and worried need the lids and brows to do the work.
  • Wide silhouette: suits the banner (side view), less so square slots and an icon.
B

Chibi: big head, glossy eyes, blush

Idea
  • Sticker proportions: the head is about 60% of the height, with a crisp snout block, big glossy eyes and warm blush.
  • Reads best at 40 px, and the face carries every mood (the eyes alone can do happy, sleepy and worried).
  • Rig: the head is its own shape, so a head bob or tilt needs only 1 head bone and no skinning. 20 to 25 shapes, no clips.
Watch
  • The least capybara of the three. In three-quarter it edges toward hamster or bear, and only the snout block says capybara.
  • Cutest rather than "chill guardian".
C

Sentinel: sits upright, the guardian pose

Idea
  • Sits up like a dog on watch, chest out, with the yuzu as a crown. "Guardian" comes from the pose, not from a prop.
  • A square silhouette: it fills a 40 px square, an empty state and an app-icon circle without wasted space. The three-quarter is the strongest icon candidate.
  • Same soft muzzle as A, with small glossy eyes (a middle ground between A and B).
  • Rig: 2 bones (body, head) with the head as its own shape, plus a front-paw shape for the tap and key poses. 18 to 22 shapes, 1 clip.
Watch
  • The sitting body is plain from the side (a single crease marks the thigh). Sleepy is a head droop, not a curled loaf.
  • A new pose, so it looks less like the old board art.

?

My recommendation

C Sentinel, because it is the only one where "guardian" shows in the silhouette, and its square shape fits every planned slot, including the undecided app icon. If you want more personality in the face, borrow B's eyes (bigger and glossier, with blush); that costs 2 to 4 shapes. Pick B if readability at 40 px matters most, or A if you want the most true-to-life capybara.

Not done yet, on purpose: no expressions, no bones or animation, no PocketBase or app changes. Those come after your pick (step 5: expression sheet, rig plan, placement plan in docs/design/pages/mascot.{md,html}).
